title: Local comparison of fan charts under a strict log morphism
statement: Let $f:(Y,N)\to(X,M)$ be a strict morphism of fs Zariski log schemes [def-trf-fs-log-blowup, lem-trf-log-fan-chart-blowup], and let $d:(Y,\overline N)\to G$ and $c:(X,\overline M)\to F$ be fan charts to fine fans [def-trf-fine-fan-blowup]. For each point $y\in Y$ there is a Zariski neighborhood $U$ of $y$, contained in the inverse images of the affine fan localizations $G_{d(y)}$ and $F_{c(f(y))}$, and an isomorphism of these localized fans $\lambda:G_{d(y)}\xrightarrow{\sim}F_{c(f(y))}$, such that $c\circ f|_U=\lambda\circ d|_U$. Here $F_z$ denotes the affine open subfan of generalizations of $z$, whose sharp monoid of sections is $\mathcal P_{F,z}$. The induced map on monoids of sections is the map obtained from $\mathcal P_{F,c(f(y))}\simeq\overline M_{f(y)}\simeq\overline N_y\simeq\mathcal P_{G,d(y)}$.
